speaker: elder
text: The Reverser pulled you back. It always will.

speaker: elder
text: But every rewind leaves less of you, and more of your reflection.

speaker: elder
text: Careful. There's more reflection in you than you, now.

speaker: system
text: SANITY LOST

speaker: you
text: Something's wrong with me... I can't stop.

speaker: elder
text: Will you train with me?

speaker: system
text: Block just as it lands. The mirror sends it back.

speaker: system
text: Good.

speaker: elder
text: Welcome inside the Reverser. This village is only a memory, rebuilt in light.

speaker: elder
text: Out there, every world's clock runs down. Close the crack before it hits zero, or that timeline shatters.

speaker: elder
text: I can train you, or send you straight through.

speaker: elder
text: Remember this. A mirror returns what it is given. Strike your reflection, and you strike yourself.

speaker: elder
text: Go. The first crack is waiting.

speaker: elder
text: Very well. Take the Divine Sword and the Mirror Shield.

speaker: elder
text: Good. Patience is a blade too.

speaker: system
text: WASD to move. Space to dash.
say: Move with W, A, S, D. Press space to dash.

speaker: system
text: [E] Take the Divine Sword

speaker: system
text: Left click to strike. Aim with the mouse.
say: Left click to strike. Aim with your mouse.

speaker: system
text: Break the crates. Red barrels explode.

speaker: system
text: [E] Take the Mirror Shield

speaker: system
text: Stand close to the dummy. Hold right click to block.
say: Stand close, and hold right click to block.

speaker: elder
text: The crack closes only when the one who made it is gone.

speaker: narrator
text: [E] Turn the blade on yourself.

speaker: narrator
text: A mirror returns what it is given. You gave it everything.

speaker: evil
text: Too late. You rewound too many times. There's more of me in you than you.

speaker: evil
text: Finally. You walked all the way back to me.

speaker: evil
text: I'm what the Reverser left behind. Every rewind, every kill... I'm made of all of it.

speaker: evil
text: Go on. Hit me. Every blow only feeds me.

speaker: narrator
text: The last fragment shows only you.

speaker: narrator
text: It moves when you move. A heartbeat before.

speaker: narrator
text: Everything you took, it took too.

speaker: narrator
text: Only one of you walks out.

speaker: you
text: This is what's left... This is what I did.

speaker: you
text: Something's waiting at the heart of this place.

speaker: you
text: The last fragment... It's waiting for me.

speaker: terminal
text: REFUGEE LOG 0417
say: Refugee log. Zero four one seven.

speaker: terminal
text: Someone tried to rewind the end of the world. Their helmet cracked time instead.

speaker: terminal
text: We fled backwards through the cracks. To the past, we look like invaders.

speaker: terminal
text: Their reflection never left. It waits at the heart of the crack.

speaker: narrator
text: The Hollow Future. The world you made. Here, the hero is the cause.

speaker: echo
text: They crossed time to escape this. In your story, they became the invaders.

speaker: echo
text: This street... it's the city. Reflected, and rotted.

speaker: system
text: HYPNO REVERSE UNLOCKED

speaker: system
text: THE PACK HAS TURNED

speaker: you
text: Here, I'm the stranger. Everything runs from me.

speaker: you
text: Wait... now I'm the prey!

speaker: you
text: It's over. I made it.

speaker: you
text: Go, before they remember me.

speaker: narrator
text: The First Hunt. Ten thousand years ago. Here, the hunter becomes the hunted.

speaker: echo
text: The first hunter was afraid too.

speaker: you
text: They're pouring out of the cracks. Hold the line!

speaker: you
text: The mirror's open. Go!

speaker: system
text: [Q] Hypno Reverse: turn their attacks against them.
say: Press Q. Hypno Reverse turns their attacks against them.

speaker: narrator
text: The Fallen City. The present day. Here, the invaders are the ones running.

speaker: echo
text: Day three. The lights in the sky look like campfires.

speaker: echo
text: Evacuation notice: the creatures aren't attacking. They're running from something.

speaker: you
text: The door won't open. Not from this side.

speaker: you
text: Ugh... my head.

speaker: you
text: Where am I?

speaker: elder
text: Put on the Reverser. Please. Time is running out... backwards.

speaker: elder
text: Easy. You've been asleep a long time.
say: Easy... easy. You've been asleep a long time.

speaker: elder
text: That helmet is the Reverser. You built it. It turns time backwards.

speaker: elder
text: You wore it to undo the end of the world. Instead, time cracked like a mirror, and now every era runs in reverse.

speaker: elder
text: It eats memories. That's why you can't remember. And when you fall, it rewinds you... but less of you comes back.

speaker: you
text: Wait... I did this?

speaker: elder
text: You did. So only you can close it. Put it on. Follow the cracks back.

speaker: you
text: It's running. Strike now!

speaker: system
text: CONTROLS REVERSED

speaker: evil
text: I know that trick. I am that trick.

speaker: evil
text: Mirror.

speaker: reflection
text: I can't follow you anymore. You're becoming the other one.

speaker: you
text: I sense something nearby...

speaker: you
text: I smell something good!

speaker: narrator
text: The mirror goes still.

speaker: narrator
text: Time takes a breath... and moves forward again.
say: Time takes a breath... and moves forward, again.

speaker: narrator
text: Somewhere ahead, the sky stays whole.

speaker: narrator
text: No one will remember who closed the crack.

speaker: narrator
text: That was the point.

speaker: evil
text: The mirror smiles back.

speaker: evil
text: Your reflection steps out into the world, wearing your face.

speaker: evil
text: The crack never closes. Time keeps running backwards.

speaker: evil
text: Faster now.

speaker: evil
text: Somewhere, someone is running from you.

speaker: hypnotic
text: Look at me. Closer. ...Which way is up now?
say: Look at me. Closer... closer. Which way is up now?

speaker: hypnotic
text: You'll see it too. Soon.

speaker: warden
text: Hold the portal. Whatever it costs.

speaker: warden
text: ...It's already too late for us.
say: It's... already too late for us.

speaker: sentinel
text: You again. You always come back.

speaker: sentinel
text: We only wanted somewhere to run.

speaker: you
text: A Flare Bow. Arrows made of light.

speaker: you
text: A Hunter's Axe. Heavy. Honest.

speaker: you
text: An Echo Wand. It hums with a future that shouldn't exist.

speaker: evil
text: Again.

speaker: evil
text: Stronger. Thank you.

speaker: evil
text: You can't outfight yourself.

speaker: evil
text: Every hit feeds me.

speaker: evil
text: There's only one way this ends.

speaker: reflection
text: I'm your reflection. The part of you that still wants to save them. Let's go.

speaker: reflection
text: I'm still with you.
